hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push|gh pr create'; then echo 'Running pre-push checks (vp run typecheck)...' >&2; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$root" && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.13.1/bin:$PATH" && (command -v vp >/dev/null || npm install -g vite-plus --prefix "$HOME/.local") && vp run typecheck || { echo 'Pre-push checks failed. Fix errors before pushing.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi
